answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. What survives to the sable is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The fable is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the bridge. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
